requirement: brief: turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus (readiness PR-09)
membership_rule: rows with both final scores present AND gameday <= 2026-11-12

train.use: any fitting, threshold choice, rating estimation

validation.use: model selection only; never reported as final

holdout.use: may not be reported on until opened
holdout.holdout_opened_note: add a dated record here (reason + decision link) in a later commit before any holdout number is published anywhere

price_policy.note: observed prices only for scoring; the -110 assumption used by data/model/strategies.json is retired for future runs pending decision PR-10

official_verification.verified_subset: 2026 games: 136 rows in data/verified/games_2026.csv (each row carries its official nfl.com week-page URL) + the official WAS 24-21 NYG final of 2026-11-12 absent from that file (flag F49)
official_verification.unverified_subset: 1999-2025 games are nflverse (third-party, CC-BY-4.0) parses of the NFL schedule feed; they are NOT matched to official pages (readiness PR-02)

amendment_rule: membership may only be extended by a new corpus_id in a later commit; the frozen counts above are never edited
